summary: The village's own site says only 'Park with RV parking, includes showers and hook-ups' (showers confirmed). No 2024+ rate anywhere (last camper report $20 in 7/2023, full hookups). Google open, 4.8/32, phone matches. Stored pin ~125 m SE in a lawn among houses; Google's pin is in the tree row by the ballfields. Everything else left.
flags: RATE: none dated 2024 or later. The village's site posts no rate; RV Life campers paid $15 (8/2021) and $20 (8/2022, 7/2023). Fees left empty.

HOOKUPS question (not changed): the 7/2023 RV Life reviewer says 'Full hook ups for $20'; stored hookups are electric 30 + water (no sewer) from 2026-09 note prose. The village's 'hook-ups' doesn't say which. Neither is a 2024+ operator statement, so left.
SITE COUNT/LENGTH unverified: stored 20 sites and max_rig_ft 35 (derived from note prose) aren't on the village's page; an 8/2021 camper describes 'maybe a dozen campsites'. Left.

PIN question: stored 42.60450,-99.13950 falls in an open lawn beside houses south of E 7th St; Google's listing pin 42.60537,-99.14044 (~125 m NW) is in the tree row north of 7th St beside the ballfields, near the race track the 2022 reviewer mentions. I could not make out the pads on imagery, so no corrected coordinate; Google's pin is the better guess.

NOISE (note lead): 8/2022 RV Life: 'there is an auto race track right next to the park' (the track is visible just north of the ballfields). The village's own events list includes 'Summer Stock Car Races'. Worth a line in the note if AWH wants one.
WEBSITE: stuartne.com is the village's community site and is what Google lists; fine. Phone 402-924-3647 matches Google.
